verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents running Claude through your own Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API, authenticating Codex for sessions, choosing models from a selector across agent backends, and bringing your own agent harness. That is real bring-your-own-provider and model-choice support, but the evidence covers only a few named model families and providers, not arbitrary LLMs or API keys. Missing for 10: explicit API-key configuration docs, support for arbitrary or self-hosted model endpoints beyond Claude/Codex/Bedrock, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice

citations.quote: HumanLayer sessions can run Claude through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API.
This guide shows you how to install, authenticate, select, and check Codex for HumanLayer sessions.
Pick GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, or Claude Opus 5.5 from the model selector across all agent backends.
Bring your own compute, development environment, and agent harness
